#DC : Movie Review 💥🍿

Arun Matheashwaran is the real show-stealer. Despite the low expectations after his previous outing, I always wondered why someone as talented as him hadn't achieved bigger success. With DC, he has proved that he belongs among the top league of directors.

The writing and screenplay are beautifully crafted. Both halves of the film kept me thoroughly satisfied in every aspect.

Lokesh Kanagaraj, despite being trolled for his looks and other reasons, has silenced the criticism with his performance. What an impressive act! He absolutely shines, especially during the interval block, which is a complete banger. Kollywood has found another hero, and he is more than welcome.

Anirudh—wow! He has absolutely blown me away. The background score and songs are the heart and soul of the film, elevating every moment to the next level. This is pure musical madness from him for his friend Loki.

Sanjana's screen time is limited but highly impactful. On the other hand, Wamiqa Gabbi literally carries the film alongside Lokesh with an equally strong presence.

The supporting cast, especially those who share screen space with Lokesh, have all done a fantastic job. The head cop's character is perfectly written and aptly portrayed.

DC carries a simple social message beneath its action-packed revenge drama, but it's the treatment that makes it truly worth watching.

Final Verdict: Super Hit

Rating: 3.75/5 ⭐⭐⭐✨

#DC REVIEW / MY OPINION 

A RADIOLUCENT REVENGE SAGA 

Before The frames Shot's and act's they've put Guts infront of everything , while making this film . 

First the guts came and later everything came .
 
usually I don’t like Arun Matheshwaran’s work , some of his film's are ick to me , I used to not like the way he depicts the violence for example in captain Miller , but for DC he has outshined himself , so I love the way how the violence arises from the character itself , and the violence depiction was also done in a very very beautiful manner . 

I want to appreciate every department that has been involved in making this Film, the set department, art department, the costume designing department, the make-up department, the prosthetic department, and the camera department most importantly.

 Anirudh's score and BGM work for this Film has to be inserted in the history books , this was his historical work ever ever ever ever ever ever , I repeat it that’s it he has given  historical Music to this Film.

Wamiqa Gabbi , I can’t even express how of a good Actress she is , there is acting in the way she looks , the way she opens or closes her eyes , the way she behaves , the way she stands, the way she walks , the way she runs, the way she holds the gun , every thing she does has acting inserted in it . She's indeed India's best actress no doubt . 

Lokesh was as usual terrific I didn’t expect the range of acting this guy can pull off, like there is this saying in the filmmaking world, that director's who can inact can also be the best Actors , Lokesh proved it right .

The pre-interval sequence and the interval fight has given a seat edge thriller experience,  and the interval fight gives the audience a feeling of suffocation , so imagine how well the director has carried audience into the film I loved it terrific. 

like the price I paid for the Film ticket, has been recovered for the first half itself, so I felt the second half and the climax were bonus to me, and I want to say this is the best way to end the film the climax was very very very very very very satisfying. 

if you have got time please go and watch this film and make yourself a favour.

4.5/5
also kenathukadavu kanagaraj cooked 😭 idha sona adipinga nenakren but i felt lokesh as an actor >> lokesh as a director
